steps.action:
# Click the browser's address bar to focus it for entering a new URL
pyautogui.click(x=152, y=64, duration=0.2)

# Type "weather.com" into the address bar and submit to navigate to Weather.com
pyautogui.typewrite('weather.com\n', interval=0.05)

# Click the bottom Dock "Show Applications" grid icon to open the applications overview
pyautogui.click(x=36, y=740, duration=0.2)

# Click the bottom-most 3×3 grid “Show Applications” icon on the dock to open the applications overview
pyautogui.click(x=25, y=760, duration=0.2)

# Click the Terminal icon (black screen with '>_' symbol) on the left dock to open a terminal window
pyautogui.click(x=23, y=427, duration=0.2)

# Click the black “>_” Terminal icon on the left dock (just above the orange bag icon) to open a terminal window
pyautogui.click(x=24, y=585, duration=0.2)

# Click the black “>_” Terminal icon (just below the green LibreOffice Calc icon) on the left dock to open a terminal window
pyautogui.click(x=25, y=520, duration=0.2)

# Click the black “>_” Terminal icon located below the GIMP icon on the left dock to open a terminal window
pyautogui.click(x=24, y=648, duration=0.2)

# Type command to fetch a text-based monthly-style weather display for Manchester from wttr.in and execute
pyautogui.typewrite('curl -s http://wttr.in/Manchester?m\n', interval=0.05)

# Fetch and display monthly forecast for Manchester from wttr.in using wget
pyautogui.typewrite('wget -qO- http://wttr.in/Manchester?M\\n', interval=0.05)

# Clear the incorrect command line in the Terminal using Ctrl+U
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'u')

# Type and execute a command to display the monthly ASCII weather forecast for Manchester via wttr.in using wget
pyautogui.typewrite("wget -qO- 'https://wttr.in/Manchester?M'\\n", interval=0.05)
WAIT

# Clear current partial command then run wget to retrieve monthly forecast ASCII for Manchester
pyautogui.typewrite(['ctrl','u','w','g','e','t',' ','-','q','O','-',' ','h','t','t','p','s',':','/','/','w','t','t','r','.','i','n','/','M','a','n','c','h','e','s','t','e','r','?','M','enter'], interval=0.05)

# Run wget without proxy to fetch and display the monthly ASCII forecast for Manchester
pyautogui.typewrite("wget -qO- --no-proxy https://wttr.in/Manchester?M\n", interval=0.05)
